title: [Shopify] Fix Get Catalogs tooltip to explain company dependency
summary: The Get Catalogs action on the Shopify Catalogs page now displays a clearer tooltip explaining that it only retrieves B2B catalogs for companies already imported into Business Central.
key_points: Tooltip updated to clarify the Get Catalogs action's behavior
Users learn that the action depends on having synced companies
No catalogs are returned if no companies have been imported
Shopify integration provides better guidance to users
Minor text change to improve user experience
